surfaces.name: Vercel Static Web Frontend
surfaces.role: Public studio, casino, monetization, payload, and OS documentation surfaces.
surfaces.activation: Already deploys as static HTML on Vercel.

surfaces.name: Flutter App Layer
surfaces.role: Future mobile shell for auth, wallet display, XP, store, and sync UI.
surfaces.activation: Add mobile API contracts only after auth, consent, and no-cash-out enforcement exist.

surfaces.name: Firebase Optional Layer
surfaces.role: Optional auth, notifications, and app telemetry bridge if still connected.
surfaces.activation: Do not enable Cloud Functions or Firestore writes from this static repo without a separate backend plan.

surfaces.name: Cloudflare DNS and Edge Boundary
surfaces.role: Optional DNS, domain, bot, or caching boundary in front of Vercel-owned deployments.
surfaces.activation: Keep Vercel as deployment source of truth; DNS changes require domain-specific verification before edits.

surfaces.name: Vercel Delivery Layer
surfaces.role: Static hosting, deployments, previews, domains, headers, and Vercel Blob for file storage.
surfaces.activation: No new Functions are active in this blueprint.

surfaces.name: GitHub Source and PR Layer
surfaces.role: Source control, pull requests, validation workflow, and deployment trigger source.
surfaces.activation: Use focused PRs; avoid broad auto-build loops.

surfaces.name: Vercel Blob File Storage
surfaces.role: First-party file storage for images, documents, generated assets, profile uploads, and media.
surfaces.activation: Use immutable blob URLs and separate pointers for mutable content.

surfaces.name: Neon Relational Storage via Vercel Marketplace
surfaces.role: Future relational data for users, entitlements, audit logs, configs, purchases, and economy state.
surfaces.activation: Vercel Postgres is no longer first-party; existing databases migrated to Neon via Vercel Marketplace in December 2024.

surfaces.name: Upstash Redis Cache via Vercel Marketplace
surfaces.role: Future cache, rate counters, idempotency keys, and AI flavor dedupe.
surfaces.activation: Vercel KV is no longer first-party; existing stores migrated to Upstash Redis via Vercel Marketplace in December 2024.
